items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: His brother married one of the Peter Sisters - Ann.

ctx.x: they were from Paris, but they knew about me. The leader of the group was the bass man and there was a guitarist, tenor, pianist and drummer. l'Outa was anice place on the main street of Chamonix and it had a very large park like garden in the back. We were obliged to play every afternoon for what is known in Europe as Tea Dance and we did it in this nice garden. It would have been great if some people had come there. Tea Dancing died during the Second World War, but many people that owned clubs and dance halls…
I eventually got to know the names of the musicians but can only remember the guitarist's name which is Harry Katz. His brother married one of the Peter Sisters - Ann.

The pianist was not a jazz man but he could accompany in the old way that pianists did way back when. Harry was a fine guitarist who also played bongos. The leader was a solid bass man but not a soloist which has never been a real necessity to make a band whateve r it is.
